newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel quiet, flirts with Eastern arb.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel quiet, flirts with Eastern arb.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were notionally unchanged in slack physical trade volume on Monday, traders said.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures fell $3.75 to $211.25 a tonne, mainly on weakness in U.S. markets.
Traders said they were trying to gather information on vessel availability with a view to arbitrage trades to Asia. Most Eastern clients continue to demand dual purpose kerosene, they said.
Demand in NWE remains stagnant. The lack of interest continued to maintain pressure on cargo premiums, again talked notionally at Jan IPE +27/28. Barge premiums were drifting around Jan IPE +$25/26.
Mediterranean parcels remain around fob Med high +$5/6.
